howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 添加 Telegram 机器人支持:复制适配器和配对辅助代码,注册配对步骤,安装指定依赖并构建测试,之后可通过 Telegram 与机器人对话。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 NanoClaw 接入 Telegram 频道或添加 Telegram 机器人时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Telegram 机器人
say.note: 开始复制适配器并注册渠道

say.text: 把 Telegram 配对到 NanoClaw
say.note: 运行配对流程,生成 4 位配对码

say.text: 检查 Telegram 集成是否正常
say.note: 运行集成测试和构建验证

howto.what_en: Adds Telegram bot support to NanoClaw: copies the adapter and pairing helpers, registers the pairing step, installs a pinned dependency, builds, and runs the integration test. You can then chat with the bot via Telegram.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to integrate the Telegram channel, e.g. 'add Telegram to NanoClaw' or 'set up a Telegram bot'.

say_en.text: Add a Telegram bot to NanoClaw.

say_en.note: Runs the pairing step and shows a 4-digit code.
Runs the integration test and verifies the build.
